title: Latent Structural Categorical Matrix Completion with Application to Quasispecies Analysis
summary: Matrix completion has been extensively studied for real-valued data, but existing methods are often limited in handling categorical variables. We propose LCMC, a double-loop optimization framework for categorical matrix completion via latent factorization based on a binary tensor representation. In this setting, each categorical entry is encoded as a one-hot vector along a third tensor mode, thereby preserving its discrete, non-ordinal nature.
